capital.evidence_quote: Islamabad is the federal capital and administrative seat of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan

currency.evidence_quote: The Pakistani Rupee (PKR, Rs) is the official currency; trades around 278 PKR to 1 USD

timezone.evidence_quote: Pakistan Standard Time operates year-round on UTC+5 without seasonal daylight saving

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Pakistan is 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The national electrical power grid operating frequency is standard 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: European Type C two-pin and British Type D and M three-round-pin sockets are standard

police.evidence_quote: Dial 15 for emergency police assistance throughout Pakistan

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 1122 for Rescue 1122 emergency ambulance and paramedic dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 16 or 1122 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 1122 is the integrated national emergency response number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Facilitation Center and Tourist Police in Gilgit-Baltistan coordinate at +92 51 920 4455

advisory_headline.tr: Belucistan ve Hayber Pahtunhva sınır bölgelerinde güvenlik riskleri nedeniyle seyahat planları gözden geçirilmelidir; Gilgit-Baltistan ve Hunza vadileri turistler için son derece huzurlu ve güvenlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Reconsider travel due to security concerns in border areas; Gilgit-Baltistan, Hunza, and Skardu are exceptionally safe and welcoming.
advisory_headline.de: Reisen in Grenzgebiete sorgfältig abwägen; die Gebirgsregionen Gilgit-Baltistan und das Hunza-Tal sind sicher und gastfreundlich.
advisory_headline.ru: Соблюдайте осторожность в приграничных зонах; высокогорный регион Гилгит-Балтистан и долина Хунза безопасны и гостеприимны.
advisory_headline.es: Reconsidere viajar a zonas fronterizas; las regiones montañosas de Gilgit-Baltistán y el valle de Hunza son muy seguras.

regional_warnings.area: Balochistan province and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (former FATA)

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Pakistan reach approximately 22.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 32.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Jazz, Zong, and Telenor provide 4G SIMs in Islamabad. In Gilgit-Baltistan and northern Karakoram passes, SCO (Special Communications Organization) / SCOM is the primary cellular provider with mountain coverage.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Biometric registration with passport and visa copy is mandatory for all SIM activations

religion.value: Islam (approx. 96%, predominantly Sunni approx. 80-85% and Shia approx. 15%)
religion.evidence_quote: Islam is the state religion and the foundation of civil law, hospitality traditions, and public life

festivals.value: Shandur Polo Festival (highest polo ground on earth at 3,700m in July), Eid-ul-Fitr, Pakistan Day (March 23), Sufi Urs at Data Darbar
festivals.evidence_quote: Shandur Polo Festival is a legendary mountain spectacle played under traditional freestyle rules

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Dress modestly across the country (salwar kameez is customary; shoulders and knees must be covered for all genders). Alcohol sales are strictly regulated and forbidden for Muslims; non-Muslim foreign tourists can obtain alcohol only at licensed 5-star international hotels. Blasphemy laws are extremely strict.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Respect for Islamic social norms, conservative attire, and religious sensitivities is paramount

tipping.value: Tipping 10% is customary in sit-down restaurants. Tipping mountain trekking porters, jeep drivers, and mountain guides in the Karakoram ($10-15 per day) is essential.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% gratuity is standard in hospitality and trekking expedition services
